statusText: WATCH: Tail remains below the blocking threshold while oil, rates and geopolitical pressure keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Current-hour NQ structure is not sufficiently verified; the main conditional risk window is Wednesday's ADP-to-EIA cluster.
headline: Overnight futures stabilize; Tail stays in WATCH ahead of Wednesday's macro-open cluster
body: No current-hour NQ observation is sufficiently verified at the cutoff. Recent evening index futures were little changed after Tuesday's selloff. Elevated oil and yields keep Stress extreme, while positive post-close technology results argue against an established one-way NQ path.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours moved from low/WATCH overnight conditions into a U.S.-session trend-down regime. Tail peaked at 47% at 19:00 UTC, then fell to 24% at 22:00 and 23% at 23:00 as one-way structure broke.
outlookSummary: Tail stays below the block threshold overnight if futures remain two-sided. Conditional risk rises around ADP at 12:15 UTC, the 13:30 cash open, Factory Orders at 14:00 and EIA at 14:30, then the Beige Book at 18:00 and Broadcom at 21:00.
